def VTask.comk : {α : Type u_1} -> (p : Set α → Prop) -> (he : p ∅) -> (hmono : ∀ (t : Set α), p t → ∀ s ⊆ t, p s) -> (hunion : ∀ (s : Set α), p s → ∀ (t : Set α), p t → p (s ∪ t)) -> Filter α :=
  fun {α} p he hmono hunion =>
    {
      sets := {s : Set α | p sᶜ}
      -- Prove that univ is in the filter
      univ_mem' := by
        have h : p (∅ : Set α) := he
        have h₁ : (⊤ : Set α)ᶜ = (∅ : Set α) := by
          simp [Set.ext_iff]
        rw [h₁]
        exact h
      -- Prove that the filter is closed under superset
      superset_mem' := by
        intro s t hs ht
        have h₁ : p sᶜ := hs
        have h₂ : sᶜ ⊆ tᶜ := by
          intro x hx
          have h₃ : x ∉ s := hx
          have h₄ : x ∉ t := by
            intro h₅
            have h₆ : x ∈ t := h₅
            have h₇ : x ∈ s := ht h₆
            contradiction
          exact h₄
        have h₃ : p tᶜ := hmono sᶜ h₁ tᶜ h₂
        exact h₃
      -- Prove that the filter is closed under pairwise intersection
      mem_inter' := by
        intro s t hs ht
        have h₁ : p sᶜ := hs
        have h₂ : p tᶜ := ht
        have h₃ : p (sᶜ ∪ tᶜ) := hunion sᶜ h₁ tᶜ h₂
        have h₄ : (s ∩ t)ᶜ = sᶜ ∪ tᶜ := by
          ext x
          simp [Set.mem_union, Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_inter_iff]
          <;> tauto
        rw [h₄] at *
        exact h₃
    }
